instruction: Go through the desktop document listing recommended plugins and install every extension except the translation tool to Chrome.

expected: Speechify Text to Speech Voice Reader

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing all extensions except Google Translate (the translation tool). Expected: Zoom, Speechify, React Developer Tools, Momentum. Uses existing evaluator functions.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'find_installed_extension_name' correctly extracts extension names from Chrome Preferences file (chrome.py:1438-1472) by reading extensions.settings[id].manifest.name
Metric 'is_expected_installed_extensions' correctly uses subset checking at chrome.py:102-117: set_expected_extensions.issubset(set_installed_extensions)
Subset checking logic is semantically appropriate: allows other extensions to be present while verifying all required ones are installed
Expected parameter handling is correct: metric accesses expected['expected'] to get the extension list, which is correct for type='rule'
Complete instruction coverage: instruction requires installing 4 specific extensions (excluding Google Translate), evaluator checks all 4 are installed
Expected extensions list is semantically correct: ['Zoom Chrome Extension', 'Speechify Text to Speech Voice Reader', 'React Developer Tools', 'Momentum']
Instruction requirement 'except the translation tool' correctly interpreted: Google Translate excluded from expected list
Data flow is semantically correct: getter returns List[str] of extension names, metric compares List[str] against expected List[str]
State accessibility: Chrome Preferences file can be read at any time after extension installation without requiring specific UI state
Postconfig correctly relaunches Chrome, ensuring Preferences file is properly written and accessible for reading
